mapper.select:
select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, EFFICIENCY, TOOLING_INFO, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK from T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
and FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}

select BEAD_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_CODE ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_CODE SEPARATOR ',') as machine_codes from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_code = m.machine_code where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by BEAD_CODE

select mouth_plate_code, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_CODE ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_CODE SEPARATOR ',') as machine_codes from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_code = m.machine_code where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0' and sm.status = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by MOUTH_PLATE_CODE

SELECT BEAD_CODE, max(MACHINE_CODE) machine_codes FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0 GROUP BY BEAD_CODE

select mc.MACHINE_CODE as machineCode, mc.INCH_SIZE as inchSize from T_TQ_MACHINE_CHUCK mc inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on mc.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE where mc.DEL_FLAG = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' and mc.INCH_SIZE is not null
